lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately six observable horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, forming a coordinate-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear trajectories are visible along the upper flank, defined by a distinct light-to-dark vertical luminance gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are visible on the first dorsal fin, with a higher spatial density observed near the fin base compared to the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge and dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibit a dense clustering of high-contrast white spots.
